👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:

Doston, gaur se dekhiye is graph ko — ye hai China ka gold purchase graph. Aur pichle 3–4 saalon me, ye graph ne aisa raftar pakdi hai ki pure duniya ke gold prices hilne lage! 🚀 Aur sirf China hi nahi… ye dekho, Russia bhi tezi se apni tijauri me gold bhar raha hai. Iske sath sath Poland, Turkey aur India bhi tezzi se apne gold reserves badha rahe hain! Infact, India increased its gold reserves from 661 tons to 879 tons in just the last 5 years!! Yaani sirf Bharat ne 220 ton gold kharid rakha hai!!
Aur asar dikhne laga hai — pichle ek saal me jahan Nifty ne 2.46% ka return diya hai, Sensex ne 2.41% ka return diya hai, lekin Gold ne lagbhag 63% ka return diya!! Pichle 5 saalon me jahan Nifty ne 117%, Sensex ne 108%, Gold ne 165% ka return diya!! Ab kai log sochte honge Gold rally toh hota rehta hai, jaise-jaise log gold kharidte hain, waise waise price badhta hai. Is it that simple!? No no no!
Doston, gold prices ke peeche chhupa hai ek aisa game of war, politics aur global power, jo aaj ki date me Russia, China aur India khel rahe hain. Aur ye gold rally koi normal price rise nahi… ye ek aisa weapon hai, jisse China aur Russia, America ke khilaf apni position mazboot banane ke liye istemal kar rahe hain!! Toh sawaal ye hai —
 1️⃣ kya hai is gold rally ka geopolitical secret?
 2️⃣ Russia aur China gold kharidkar, America ke khilaf kya plan kar rahe hain?
 3️⃣ Aur in sabke beech, kya gold me invest karna safe hai ya ek risky gamble janenge is episode??
